GPSC Revised Final Result 2026 - Check Deputy Section Officer & Deputy Mamlatdar Result at gpsc.gujarat.gov.in - Complete Details

GPSC Re-Revised Final Result 2026 has been released on 17 September for Advertisement No. 127/2024-25. Check the Deputy Section Officer and Deputy Mamlatdar result, merit list, marks, and important instructions here.

Important Dates

  • Main Exam Dates : 20 to 22 February 2026
  • Main (Written) Examination : 20-22 February 2026
  • Important notice on self-declaration for common candidates : 10 February 2026

Application Fee

  • Posts Covered : Deputy Section Officer, Class-3 (Secretariat & Vidhansabha) and Deputy Mamlatdar, Class-3

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
